message: release(v1.8.35): Chrome Web Store launch, unpacked migration update, Contact/Feedback sections, Privacy & Terms links
changelog: Connect Existing Sync Key (src/popup/index.html, src/popup/modules/settingsSync.ts): Added a Use Existing button and input panel right under Settings > Sync > Personal Sync Key so students switching to the Chrome Web Store build (or a new browser) can paste their BBS-... Sync Key or full pairing link and immediately pull their cloud vault without overwriting it.

Complete Backup Export & Restore (src/popup/modules/settingsSync.ts): Export JSON and Restore JSON now include payments, semesters (archived terms/CGPA), tombstones, and extraSites alongside tasks, courses, quickLinks, profile, and settings.
